issue.title: gateway: Codex thread permanently 400 when a relayed Responses upstream's url_citation annotations lack start_index/end_index
issue.body:
## 问题

用 Magpie 的 Codex 路由 + 自动路由组（`group/medium`）时，一条线程会被永久 400：

1. 该线程某一轮被自动路由到 `volcengine/deepseek-v4.1-flash`（Volcengine Ark 的 Responses 端点，带联网搜索），它返回的 `output_text.annotations` 是 `url_citation` 但**没有 `start_index`/`end_index`**（形状：`{type,title,url,site_name,publish_time,summary}`）。
2. Magpie 的 Responses 透传路径把这个 annotation **原样** relay 给 Codex 客户端（`internal/gateway/whole_stream.go:211-213`），Codex 写进线程历史。
3. 之后同一线程被自动路由命中 `codex/*` 成员时，历史作为 `input[]` 回放，ChatGPT/Codex 后端按 OpenAI schema 校验，每次重试都 400：
   `Codex: Invalid response.create payload: Missing required parameter: 'input[221].content[0].annotations[0].start_index'.`
4. 新开线程正常；升级 Magpie 也修不了（最新 main 仍无 `start_index` 处理）。

这跟 #2855（reasoning item 毒化，作者已在 v0.1.2497 修）是**同一类**：magpie 交给客户端的东西必须能被再发出去。这里是 annotation 版本。

### TL;DR (English)

A Codex thread routed by Magpie's auto-routing group was answered once by a non-OpenAI Responses upstream (Volcengine Ark). That reply carried `url_citation` annotations without `start_index`/`end_index`. Magpie relays a Responses upstream's annotations verbatim (`internal/gateway/whole_stream.go:211-213`), so Codex stored them in thread history. When the same thread was later routed to a `codex/*` member, the replayed `input[]` was rejected by the Codex backend on every retry:
`Codex: Invalid response.create payload: Missing required parameter: 'input[N].content[0].annotations[0].start_index'.`
The thread is permanently unusable with Codex; a new thread works. Latest main (`5daba83`, tag `v0.1.2732`) still has no `start_index` handling (non-test `git grep start_index` is empty). This is the annotation sibling of #2855 (reasoning-item poison, fixed for reasoning in v0.1.2497). Suggested fix: sanitize relayed input annotations before forwarding to `/backend-api/codex` — in `codexInputAs` (`codex_backend.go:2357`) drop `url_citation` annotations missing offsets (or fill them from `text`), matching the `reasoningTidy` precedent; also drop malformed annotations in `responsesWholeEvents`.

### 相关 issue（同一类问题）

- **#2855**：非 OpenAI 上游的 item 被 Codex 存下并回放，切回 OpenAI 后线程永久 400。作者已在 v0.1.2497 修了 **reasoning item** 的同类问题（`reasoningTidy`，`internal/gateway/reasoning_content.go`），核心原则即"magpie 交给客户端的东西必须能被再次发出去"。本 issue 是它的**兄弟**：坏 item 的字段是 `url_citation` annotation，而不是 reasoning content。
- **#3455**：magpie 代模型执行的 search 目前不给 Responses/Chat 回复补 `url_citation`；贡献者分支在 `search_cite.go` 用 `urlCites` 补 `start_index`/`end_index`。本 issue **不是**这条路径，而是**上游 Responses 自己返回的**引用被原样 relay。
- **#2044**：search 结果已作为 `web_search_call` item 保留（`action.sources`），那是 search 记录，不是 `output_text.annotations`。

### 环境

| 项 | 值 |
|---|---|
| 系统 | macOS arm64（Apple Silicon） |
| Magpie | 0.1.2723（本机）；最新 release v0.1.2731（2026-11-02 12:27 UTC），源码 tag v0.1.2732 仍受影响 |
| Codex desktop app | 26.1027.61615（2026-11-02 最新 macOS 构建） |
| codex-cli | 0.166.0-alpha.5.1（与 26.1027 匹配，不是版本错配） |
| 网关 | Magpie gateway `http://127.0.0.1:3425`，Codex 配置 `openai_base_url` 指向它 |
| 路由组 | `group/medium`（候选同时含 `codex/gpt-6.1-sol`、`codex/gpt-6-luna` 与 `volcengine/deepseek-v4.1-flash`、`volcengine/glm-5.3-flash`、`agentrouter/*` 等） |
| Volcengine 配置 | 预设 `volcengine` 配置了 Responses 端点（`https://ark.cn-beijing.volces.com/api/plan/v3`），因此走 Responses 原生对象而非 chat 转换 |

### 现象

- 2026-11-02 19:40 起，某条长期线程的每次请求都失败，错误固定为：
  `stream disconnected before completion: Codex: Invalid response.create payload: Missing required parameter: 'input[221].content[0].annotations[0].start_index'.`
- Magpie gateway 日志（`~/Library/Logs/magpie/app.log`）：
  ```
  2026/11/02 20:00:08 gateway: codex's call to group/medium on codex failed: 400 after 36.119s:
  Codex: Invalid response.create payload: Missing required parameter:
  'input[221].content[0].annotations[0].start_index'.
  ```
  之后每轮（20:01、20:02、20:03、20:04、20:06、20:07、20:08、20:09、20:11……）全部重复同一错误；`(and N times more like it since the last line)` 说明是同一 payload 的 5 次重试。
- 同期新开的线程完全正常（19:42 新建的线程 19:53 正常拿到回答），所以排除鉴权、网络、全局配置问题。
- 只要把该线程切到 `codex/gpt-6.1-sol` 也一样 400（20:05:17 日志），说明与"请求本轮路由到哪个 codex 模型"无关，而是**历史输入**被校验。

### 根因链（本地证据）

**第 1 步：该线程某一轮由 Volcengine 回答（非 Codex 上游）**

Magpie 路由日志 `~/.config/magpie/routing/2026-11-02.jsonl`：
```json
{"time":"2026-11-02T15:02:47.633+08:00","agent":"codex","model":"group/medium","provider":"agentrouter",
 "tries":[{"id":"volcengine","model":"deepseek-v4.1-flash","done":true,"status":200,"ms":…}]}
```

**第 2 步：这一轮的回答在 Codex 线程历史里带上了 Volcengine 风格的 `url_citation`，且缺 offsets**

Codex 的 rollout（`~/.codex/sessions/2026/10/12/rollout-2026-10-12T15-14-03-<thread>.jsonl`）该条 `response_item`（assistant `output_text`）里的 annotation 形状：
```json
{"type":"url_citation","title":"…","url":"https://…","site_name":"…","publish_time":"…","summary":"…"}
```
（共 2 个，均为该形状；没有 `start_index` / `end_index`。）

同一个线程里其它正常引用（来自 OpenAI 上游）则是标准形状：
```json
{"type":"url_citation","start_index":90,"end_index":152,"url":"https://…","title":"…"}
```

**第 3 步：之后自动路由命中 codex 成员，坏历史被回放 → 400**

路由日志（同一线程，19:40 之后）：
```json
{"time":"2026-11-02T19:40:45.630+08:00","model":"group/medium","provider":"agentrouter",
 "tries":[{"id":"codex@…","model":"gpt-6-luna","done":true,"status":400,
           "error":"Codex: Invalid response.create payload: Missing required parameter:
                    'input[221].content[0].annotations[0].start_index'."}]}
```
非 codex 成员走 chat 转换，不会因为该字段报错；只有 `on codex` 的尝试 400。所以表现为"同一条线程有时能聊、有时永久报错"——取决于自动路由本轮是否命中 codex 成员。

### 为什么是 Magpie 的问题（最新源码仍存在）

- Responses 透传路径把上游 annotation 原样发回客户端，未做 schema 归一化：
  `internal/gateway/whole_stream.go:211-213`（v0.1.2732）：
  ```go
  json.Unmarshal(part["annotations"], &notes)
  for k, a := range notes {
      send("response.output_text.annotation.added", ids(obj{"annotation_index": raw(k), "annotation": a}))
  }
  ```
- OpenAI Responses 的 `url_citation` 要求 `start_index`/`end_index`；非 OpenAI 上游（此例 Volcengine Ark 的 Responses 端点）的引用对象没有这两个字段。
- Codex 客户端把该 annotation 原样落进线程历史；后续轮次把它作为 `input[]` 发回 Codex 后端，后端严格校验 → 400。
- 最新源码（tag v0.1.2732 / main `5daba83`）**没有**任何 `start_index` 处理：
  `git grep start_index v0.1.2732 -- '*.go' | grep -v _test` 为空；`whole_stream.go` 的透传逻辑与 0.1.2723 一致。0.1.2723 → 最新 release 的 diff 也没有 annotations/引用相关改动。**所以升级 Magpie 不能解决。**
- 这也不属于 Codex 版本错配：Codex app 26.1027.61615 是当前最新 macOS 构建，自带 codex-cli 0.166.0-alpha.5.1 正是该版本对应组合。

### 建议修复

1. **请求侧自愈（推荐，能救已污染线程）**
   在 `internal/gateway/codex_backend.go` 的 `codexInputAs`（v0.1.2732:2357，已在转发 `/backend-api/codex` 前重写 `input[]`）里增加一步：遍历 `input[].content[]`，对 `type == "output_text"` 的 `annotations`：
   - `url_citation` 缺 `start_index`/`end_index` → 删除该 annotation（最安全）；
   - 或按 `title`/`url` 在 `text` 中定位后补齐区间。
   这样用户不用弃线程，旧线程下一次请求即可恢复。
2. **响应侧**
   在 `responsesWholeEvents`（或所有非 Codex 上游的 Responses 转换/透传）里，丢弃或补齐不符合 OpenAI schema 的 annotation，从源头避免污染。

### 复现

- 组内含 `codex/*` 与非 OpenAI Responses 上游（如 `volcengine/*`，且该上游会带联网搜索引用）；
- 第 1 轮让 group 命中 volcengine（返回缺 offsets 的 `url_citation`）；
- 第 2 轮让 group 命中 codex → 该线程之后永久 400。
- 或直接构造最小请求验证：`POST /backend-api/codex`，`input` 中一条 assistant message 的 `content[0]` 为
  `{"type":"output_text","text":"x","annotations":[{"type":"url_citation","url":"https://example.com","title":"e"}]}` → 预期 400 `Missing required parameter: 'input[0].content[0].annotations[0].start_index'`。

### 临时绕过（用户侧）

- 新开线程（最省事，用户当前采用）；
- 或该线程固定使用非 Codex 成员（不推荐，Codex 模型不可用）；
- 或清理本地线程历史里的坏 annotation（实测可行：删除那 2 个引用、保持 rollout 文件字节长度不变，重开 Codex 后旧线程恢复）。

### 证据位置（本机，可按需脱敏提供）

- `~/Library/Logs/magpie/app.log` — gateway 400 日志；
- `~/.config/magpie/routing/2026-11-02.jsonl` — 15:02 volcengine 命中记录、19:40 起 codex 400 记录；
- `~/.codex/sessions/2026/10/12/rollout-<date>-<thread-id>.jsonl`（线程 ID 已脱敏，如需可私信提供）— 含坏 annotation 的历史项；该线程从 2026-10-12 持续到 11-02；
- `~/.codex/logs_2.sqlite` 中 `codex_core::responses_retry` 的 5/5 重试记录。

comments.body:
Reproduced and fixed on a branch — thanks for the exceptionally complete report (routing log + rollout shape + minimal repro), it made the root cause traceable end to end.

**Root cause.** Magpie relays a whole Responses reply from another vendor as that vendor's own events, annotations included. Ark writes `url_citation` with no `start_index`/`end_index`; Codex stores what it is handed, and when the thread next lands on a `codex/*` member the replayed history fails OpenAI's schema check — `Missing required parameter: 'input[N].content[0].annotations[0].start_index'` — on every retry, forever. Same class as #2855: what magpie hands a client must be something magpie could send again. #3887's `encrypted_content` strip doesn't cover annotations.

**Fix** (drops the unsendable citation at both seams, the way the reasoning-item fix did):

- **Reply side**: a whole reply streamed as the vendor's events drops an annotation lacking either offset in every place a client reads a citation — the `response.output_text.annotation.added` events, `content_part.done`, `output_item.done`, and the `response.completed` object (`dropOffsetlessCitations` in `internal/gateway/whole_stream.go`). The text, and a citation that carries its offsets, go exactly as the vendor wrote them.
- **Request side** (`withoutOffsetlessCitations` in `internal/gateway/codex_backend.go`, beside `withoutReasoningText` of #1411): such an annotation leaves the replayed history on its way to the ChatGPT backend — on Codex's own sign-in and compaction relay, on a `codex/*` group member / openai.com / Azure upstream in the provider loop, and, where a relay in front of the backend names the parameter, the request is asked again without it and the provider marked so it is never sent one again. **A thread already poisoned heals on its next turn — no new thread, no manual rollout surgery.** A turn whose items name no `"annotations"` is not decoded (the #1532 scan discipline holds).

Dropping rather than filling `0/len`: the schema wants real offsets, and a vendor that omits them says nothing about where the citation sits — a filled pair would highlight text the citation is not about; dropping keeps the text, which is what the thread needs.

**Verification** (branch `fix/4921-citation-offsets`, commit `fcea11649`, on top of main `8abdf53a8`):

| What | Result |
|---|---|
| The three new tests on clean main (ablation) | red — the citation relays to the client, and both the relay and the ChatGPT backend answer with your exact 400 |
| Same tests on the branch | green: reply-side drop, retry-without on the relay, pre-strip on the backend, cited-with-offsets kept in all four places |
| `TestCodexRewritesAsBefore` / `...LeaveTurnUndecoded` + fuzz | ok — the rewrite is held to its scan, an unmarked turn is not decoded |
| gofmt / `go vet -tags nogui` (linux, windows) / `go build -tags nogui` | clean |

**Boundary**: tested against the annotation shape you captured via a fake upstream that answers with your exact error; not verified against a real Ark account or a real poisoned Codex-desktop thread (the mechanism — replay-side strip — is the same one that healed #2855's threads). A vendor that *streams* offsetless citations byte-for-byte still plants them, but the replay-side strip heals those threads the same way; if one shows up, the same rule goes into the stream tidy.

This is a fork branch, offered for review; not a claim on the issue.

Verified skygunner's branch: cherry-picked `fcea11649` onto today's `main` (`cb7d7f9aa`) and ran it — **PASS**. The pick auto-merges clean (no conflicts; the drift since their base `8abdf53a8` is one usage-ledger commit, none of it touching these hunks), the build is ok, `gofmt` and `go vet -tags nogui` are clean, and every test is green at the tip:

| What (on `cb7d7f9aa` + their commit) | Result |
|---|---|
| Their three new tests — `TestCitationsWithoutOffsetsAskedAgainWithout`, `TestCitationsWithoutOffsetsNotSentToCodexBackend`, `TestWholeAsStreamDropsCitationsWithoutOffsets` | ok |
| The rewrite/scan harness with their new entry — `TestCodexRewritesAsBefore`, `TestCodexRewritesLeaveTurnUndecoded`, `FuzzCodexRewritesAsBefore` (seed corpus) | ok |

My patch (`57dc7b420`, posted above) also cherry-picks clean onto the same tip and its three tests pass there, so **both versions are current as of today's main**. Not re-run by me: their red-on-base ablation (their table records it on `8abdf53a8`); the full gateway suite on either tree (it carries the known host-dependent `TestCodexPoolSaysTheClientsVersion` on this machine, unrelated to both diffs).

The two patches agree on everything that matters and differ in one place — coverage breadth on the request side:

| | mine `57dc7b420` | theirs `fcea11649` |
|---|---|---|
| Reply side | `tidyCitations` inside the per-item loop of `responsesWholeEvents` — covers all four places a client reads (annotation.added, content_part.done, output_item.done, response.completed) | `dropOffsetlessCitations` pre-cleans the whole output before the same loop — the same four outlets, same rule |
| ChatGPT-backend path (codex member, own sign-in, compaction) | strip in `codexInputAs` | strip in `codexUpstreamOn` — same requests, one funnel later |
| Codex API-key base (api.openai.com/v1) | stripped (`codexInput` runs before base selection) | not stripped (theirs is gated on the ChatGPT base) |
| Passthrough to api.openai.com / Azure / a codex account | not covered | pre-stripped |
| Passthrough to any other relay upstream | not covered | asked once more without the citation on the exact 400, and the provider remembered — the same refuse-and-remember as #1411, in-process only, one extra ask per provider+model per process, bounded (their test asserts 2 asks, then 1) |
| Magpie models through codex accounts | left as they came (`!magpieModel` guard) | stripped too — harmless but lossy, those models accept offsetless citations |
| Drop, not fill 0/len | fail-closed, same reason | fail-closed, same reason |
| Tests | 3 (incl. a scan-predicate unit test) + fuzz marks | 3 end-to-end (relay retry with ask counts, backend pre-strip, whole-stream) + a rewrite-parity entry of their own + fuzz marks |

Both versions are here for the maintainer to pick from. They would coexist — disjoint helper names, different anchor hunks, each applies clean at the tip — but they double-strip at both seams, so one is enough. If theirs lands, mine is superseded on behavior except two narrow faces (the API-key base above, and the magpie-model guard), and my tests keep passing against their tree. If mine lands, their passthrough pre-strip + retry-without is a self-contained increment (the `gateway.go` hunks plus the `codexUpstreamOn` hunk) worth taking as a follow-up — relay coverage is the one face of the reporter's group shape mine doesn't reach.

**Not verified** (either side): a real Volcengine Ark account — both fixes are tested against the captured annotation shape through a strict fake upstream, and no real poisoned Codex-desktop thread replayed end to end.

This is a verification post, not a new delivery — the `take` stands from my earlier comment.

已合入 v0.1.2766（c86fa2a34）。采用的是 skygunner 的版本（fcea11649），没有用 ggbdpq 的 57dc7b420。原因：57dc7b420 只在请求的不是 magpie 模型时才去掉引用，而报告里的路径（路由组的 codex 成员，历史原样透传）恰好不在这个范围里，坏的 annotation 还是会发出去。ggbdpq 的对照表和对报告的复现用来核对了这个版本。
评审时还改了一处：只检查 url_citation 和 container_file_citation 是否缺 start_index/end_index。file_citation 和 file_path 本来就只有一个 index，原补丁会把它们全当成「缺偏移」删掉。新增 TestCitationsWithOneIndexKept 覆盖这一点。
没有用真实的火山引擎到 Codex 的对话试过。

| Tests | 3 (incl. a scan-predicate unit test) + fuzz marks | 3 end-to-end (relay retry with ask counts, backend pre-strip, whole-stream) + a rewrite-parity entry of their own + fuzz marks |

Both versions are here for the maintainer to pick from. They would coexist — disjoint helper names, different anchor hunks, each applies clean at the tip — but they double-strip at both seams, so one is enough. If theirs lands, mine is superseded on behavior except two narrow faces (the API-key base above, and the magpie-model guard), and my tests keep passing against their tree. If mine lands, their passthrough pre-strip + retry-without is a self-contained increment (the `gateway.go` hunks plus the `codexUpstreamOn` hunk) worth taking as a follow-up — relay coverage is the one face of the reporter's group shape mine doesn't reach.

**Not verified** (either side): a real Volcengine Ark account — both fixes are tested against the captured annotation shape through a strict fake upstream, and no real poisoned Codex-desktop thread replayed end to end.

This is a verification post, not a new delivery — the `take` stands from my earlier comment.

已合入 v0.1.2766（c86fa2a34）。采用的是 skygunner 的版本（fcea11649），没有用 ggbdpq 的 57dc7b420。原因：57dc7b420 只在请求的不是 magpie 模型时才去掉引用，而报告里的路径（路由组的 codex 成员，历史原样透传）恰好不在这个范围里，坏的 annotation 还是会发出去。ggbdpq 的对照表和对报告的复现用来核对了这个版本。
评审时还改了一处：只检查 url_citation 和 container_file_citation 是否缺 start_index/end_index。file_citation 和 file_path 本来就只有一个 index，原补丁会把它们全当成「缺偏移」删掉。新增 TestCitationsWithOneIndexKept 覆盖这一点。
没有用真实的火山引擎到 Codex 的对话试过。

issue.title: gateway: Codex thread fails with 400/404 `Item with id 'rs_…' not found` after returning from a fallback provider to a `codex=as-sent` relay (or a relay that reports the 404 as an SSE `error` event under HTTP 200)

repository.name: magpie
repository.description: Every agent's model. One place. Codex on DeepSeek, Claude Code on Kimi, from the menu bar.

issue.body:
### magpie version

v0.1.3616 (also verified on latest `main` / `v0.1.3631`, commit `6af54dc9a`, where the relevant code paths in `internal/gateway/gateway.go`, `internal/gateway/codex_backend.go`, and `internal/gateway/fallback.go` remain unchanged)

### Where

gateway (`Gateway only`)

### OS

Windows 11

## What happens

When a Codex CLI / Desktop session routed through an ordered routing group (`stays=auto`) temporarily falls back from a primary OpenAI / ChatGPT Codex relay (`codex=as-sent`) to a secondary provider that produces bare `reasoning` items (`id: "rs_..."` and `summary`, without `encrypted_content`), and later switches back to the primary relay after its quota cooldown expires, every subsequent turn in that thread fails permanently with:

```text
Item with id 'rs_…' not found. Items are not persisted when `store` is set to false. Try again with `store` set to true, or remove this item from your input.
```

Magpie records the attempt as `status: 400, fail: "other"`, does not strip the bare `reasoning` item, does not mark the provider with `bareReasoningRefused`, and does not fail over to the next group member. Codex retries 5 times on the same member and the thread stays stuck until the primary member is manually disabled or a new conversation is started.

## Minimal reproduction sequence

1. Configure an ordered routing group (`routing: "order"`, default `stays=auto`) with two `/v1/responses` members:
   - Member 1 (primary): a relay in front of the OpenAI / ChatGPT Codex backend configured with `codex=as-sent` (`CodexAsSent: true`), which enforces `store: false` and forwards upstream errors as SSE `event: error` frames over an HTTP `200 OK` (`Content-Type: text/event-stream`) stream.
   - Member 2 (fallback): a provider where Magpie translates the reply (`responsesEncoder` in `internal/gateway/responses.go`) or rewrites plain reasoning (`magpieMadeReasoning` in `internal/gateway/reasoning_content.go`), returning a `reasoning` output item with `id: "rs_..."` and `summary`, but no `encrypted_content`.
2. Start a Codex session (`"store": false`). Member 1 returns `429` (quota exhausted) and rests; Magpie fails over to Member 2, which answers `200` and appends a bare `reasoning` item (`encrypted_content: ""`) to the Codex rollout history.
3. Wait for Member 1's quota rest window to expire, then send the next turn in the same Codex session (which replays the full `input` history with `"store": false`, including the bare `rs_…` item from step 2).
4. Magpie's `stoodIn` affinity rule routes the new turn back to Member 1. The upstream rejects the bare `rs_…` item with `Item with id 'rs_…' not found. Items are not persisted when store is set to false.`

## Root cause

Checked against `main` (`v0.1.3631`, commit `6af54dc9a`). Two independent gaps in `internal/gateway/gateway.go` prevent `withoutBareReasoning` from running both before and after the request is sent:

1. **Pre-send cleanup in `(*Server).passthrough` is skipped when `codex=as-sent` is enabled (`internal/gateway/gateway.go:6351-6385`)**:
   - In `passthrough`, `if codexAsSent(p, r.Header) { break }` (lines `6351-6356`) exits the `case provider.Responses:` block before reaching `withoutBareReasoning(body)`, `withoutReasoningText(body)`, and `withoutOffsetlessCitations(body)` (lines `6381-6399`), even if `!s.fits(p.ID, bareReasoningRefused(model), proto)` is already true or `withoutClaudeSeals(body)` at line `6335` just stripped a Claude seal leaving a bare `reasoning` item behind.
   - Native Codex + OpenAI turns always seal `reasoning` items with `encrypted_content` (`keepsSeal` in `internal/gateway/codex_backend.go:3484-3488`), so a bare `reasoning` item in `input` never originates from Codex's own OpenAI shape—it only comes from an earlier turn on another vendor (just like `codexInputAs` in `internal/gateway/codex_backend.go:2643-2664` already strips `enc == ""` and non-empty `content` unconditionally for the direct ChatGPT backend).

2. **Post-error recovery in `(*Server).passthrough` and `(*Server).serve` misses `Item with id 'rs_…' not found` when returned as an SSE `error` event under HTTP `200 OK` (`internal/gateway/gateway.go:6765-6869` and `4371-4403`)**:
   - The ChatGPT Codex WebSocket backend (and relays in front of it) can deliver an `invalid_request_error` (`status: 404`, `"Item with id 'rs_…' not found..."`) as the first SSE frame (`event: error`) of an HTTP `200 OK` (`text/event-stream`) response.
   - Because `res.StatusCode == 200`, the `for proto != provider.Anthropic && badRequest(res.StatusCode)` retry loop inside `passthrough` (`internal/gateway/gateway.go:6765`, which calls `refusesInput` -> `withoutBareReasoning` at lines `6853-6869`) is completely skipped.
   - Outside `passthrough`, `holdWriter` (`streamEvent` at `internal/gateway/fallback.go:4012-4069` and `streamStatus` at `4662-4683`) holds the error frame before anything is sent to the client and folds `"invalid_request_error"` into `hw.failure = 400`. However, in `(*Server).serve` (`internal/gateway/gateway.go:4371-4403`), the held-error retry block only checks `foreignReasoning.Match(hw.errBody())` (which matches `invalid_encrypted_content` / decryption errors and calls `withoutSeals`), and never checks `refusesInput(hw.code(), hw.errBody())` or `unreadableItem.Match(hw.errBody())`.

## Suggested fix

1. **In `(*Server).passthrough` (`internal/gateway/gateway.go:6351-6356`)**:
   Before `break` inside `if codexAsSent(p, r.Header)`, strip foreign/bare reasoning items and offsetless citations that could only have been injected by another vendor on an earlier fallback turn (while keeping all native Codex Responses Lite fields—`additional_tools`, `reasoning.context`, `client_metadata`, `stream_options`, `developer` role, `web_search`, and headers—untouched):
   ```go
   if codexAsSent(p, r.Header) {
       if !replay {
           body = withoutBareReasoning(body)
           body = withoutReasoningText(body)
       }
       body = withoutOffsetlessCitations(body)
       break
   }
   ```
2. **In `(*Server).serve` (`internal/gateway/gateway.go:4403`, right after the `foreignReasoning` block)**:
   When a held Responses error (`resealed < 2 && from == provider.Responses && !hw.passing && hw.code() >= 400`) matches `refusesInput(hw.code(), hw.errBody()) || unreadableItem.Match(hw.errBody())`, strip bare reasoning items via `withoutBareReasoning(body)` (and record `s.markUnfit(c.p.ID, bareReasoningRefused(c.model), from)`) or strip the named item via `withoutUnreadable(body, hw.errBody())`, set `try.Fail = failForeign`, and retry (`i--; continue`).

A draft patch with two regression tests covering both the `codex=as-sent` pre-send path and the HTTP 200 SSE `event: error` stream recovery path (`TestCodexAsSentStripsBareReasoningBeforeSend` and `TestBareReasoningRefusedInStreamErrorRetries` in `internal/gateway/bare_reasoning_test.go`) is available, and can be shared or submitted as a PR if maintainers agree with this direction.
